ctaHeading: Need a custom truck body in Campbellfield? Let's build it.
aboutText: Based in Campbellfield, MVP Truck Bodies brings years of precision steel fabrication to every project. From brand-new refrigerated bodies to tray rebuilds and full repairs, our experienced team is focused on quality, competitive pricing, and getting your fleet back on the road fast.
servicesText: We specialise in custom steel fabrication for trucks and commercial vehicles, delivering robust solutions tailored to your specific operational needs across Melbourne.

services.title: Custom Refrigerated Bodies
services.desc: Design and build new, insulated truck bodies for temperature-sensitive transport from our Campbellfield workshop.

services.title: Tray & Flatbed Rebuilds
services.desc: Complete reconstruction and reinforcement of worn or damaged truck trays for maximum durability.

services.title: Accident & Crash Repairs
services.desc: Expert restoration of truck bodies after collisions, ensuring structural integrity and a factory finish.

services.title: Custom Steel Fabrication
services.desc: Tailor-made steel components, toolboxes, and body modifications to suit your specific trade requirements.

services.title: General Truck Maintenance
services.desc: Routine servicing, welding repairs, and preventative maintenance to keep your fleet operational.

services.title: Fleet Consultation & Upgrades
services.desc: Advice on body specifications, materials, and upgrades to optimise your vehicle's performance and lifespan.

reviews.text: MVP rebuilt the tray on our Campbellfield delivery truck after a major accident. The quality of the steelwork was excellent, and they had us back in service quicker than we expected.

reviews.text: We had a custom refrigerated body built for our new van. The team at MVP were fantastic to deal with, and the finished product is perfect for our fresh produce runs.
reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: For reliable truck welding and repairs, we always take our vehicles to MVP in Campbellfield. Their work is always thorough and fairly priced, keeping our site trucks running.
